text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Tuesday according to the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Faced with impasse in negotiations and threat to close university, academic council sets up committee of lawyers.
- Hardening in opposition by Socialist Forces Front (FFS) after referendum to change constitution. Party plans national march for December 12.
- Killers responsible for October massacre of 38 people near Saharan town of Laghouat are eliminated.
- After official announcement of constitutional referendum results, Socialist Forces Front calls for national march.
- National Observatory to fight corruption inaugurated.
- Algeria lives moment of hope with visit of European Commission Vice President Manuel Marin.
- Green light for association between Algeria and European Union.
- Opening of new judicial year by President Liamine Zeroual.
